summary: KFIT HOME phase 2 + contact smoke-tested end-to-end (frontend only, Supabase live). 29/36 asserts PASS. WORKING (verified live): login via welcome-login-button + login-submit-button -> home-screen; tab-profile shows profile-role='ADMIN' and all three links (contact/history/admin); profile-link-admin -> admin-screen; admin-load-samples responds with admin-message 'Contenus d'exemple charges (3 / 10 / 38)'; a SECOND press of admin-load-samples does NOT duplicate (programmes stayed at 3); training-screen chip filters work (catalog-goal-muscle_gain -> only sample-hypertrophy, catalog-level-beginner -> only sample-tulum-shred, muscle_gain+beginner -> catalog-empty with FR copy); catalog-kind-video lists exactly 10 sessions, duration filters give short=0 (catalog-empty), medium=4, long=6; catalog-kind-exercise lists 38 rows and hides goal+duration chips as specified; program-detail-screen for sample-strength-balance shows meta 'Intermediate / Renforcement / 8 semaines / 0/4', program-enroll-button toggles to program-enrolled-badge, program-session-0 opens video-detail-screen, video-complete-button updates video-done-count to 'x 1' then 'x 2' (rapid double-tap allowed), returning to the programme shows progress '1/4' (distinct sessions rule honoured); contact-screen: fields present (contact-name/phone/address1/address2/postalCode/city/region/country-input), valid French payload (+52 984..., Calle Test 1, 77760, Tulum, Quintana Roo, Mexique) saves -> contact-saved visible, leaving and re-opening the screen re-reads the exact same values (REST confirmed); profile-lang-en switches catalogue/profile copy to English, profile-lang-fr restores French; regression pass: profile-link-nutrition/progress/booking all mount their screens without error; coach tab opened without sending any message. SAMPLE LOADER COUNTS match the owner's spec exactly (3 programmes / 10 videos / 38 unique exercises confirmed via catalogue which rendered all 38 rows). Cleanup for the test user is DONE: via Supabase password grant + REST (RLS applies) the user's favorites, workout_history (2 rows), program_enrollments (1 row) were deleted and client_profiles.preferences.contact was reset to empty strings; sample-* content is untouched and still published.

ui_bugs.issue: After completing sessions elsewhere in the app and returning to Home via tab-home, the Home screen does NOT refresh: home-stat-0 showed '0 Seances' and home-stat-1 showed '0 min' while workout_history actually contained 2 rows (verified via Supabase REST at cleanup); home-program-percent was absent and home-program-card still showed the 'no program' state although program_enrollments had 1 row for the user. useFocusEffect(load) at line 40 is wired correctly in source, so this looks like a native-tab focus-event quirk from expo-router/unstable-native-tabs (same component still flagged as deprecated in iterations 2/3). Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:40 and /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx (unstable-native-tabs import).

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warning carried over from iterations 2-3: 'expo-router/unstable-native-tabs is deprecated. Use expo-router/native-tabs instead.' Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx. This iteration shows a functional consequence (see Home stats not refreshing on tab switch) and no longer just cosmetic.

action_items: Fix Home stats/program-card not refreshing on tab return: migrate /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx from 'expo-router/unstable-native-tabs' to 'expo-router/native-tabs' (or add a manual refresh trigger in app/(tabs)/index.tsx via a lightweight AppState / navigation listener) so useFocusEffect fires when switching back to the home tab after completing a session.

Optional retest for coverage not exercised this run due to time budget: ADMIN CRUD path (validation errors for empty programme + invalid slug 'Bad Slug' + missing level; create qa-test-program draft -> absent from catalogue; flip is_published ON -> appears; create qa-test-exercise with muscles 'abdos, dos'; create a video attached to Programme QA duration 15 visible under Videos with duration <=20; delete all three with the double-press delete flow). Nothing in the code paths reviewed suggests these will fail, but they were not executed live this iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: app/(tabs)/index.tsx line 40: useFocusEffect(useCallback(() => { load(); }, [load])) is correct in isolation but the functional symptom observed (stats stayed at 0 after a tab round-trip while REST confirmed rows existed) points at native-tabs not emitting a focus event on tab re-selection. Suggest either (a) migrating to expo-router/native-tabs, or (b) subscribing to navigation.addListener('tabPress') and calling load() unconditionally.

app/admin/edit.tsx remove() (line 106): correct double-press confirm flow (first press sets confirm=true and shows t('confirmDelete'), second press performs the delete). testID admin-delete-button is stable; no changes needed.

app/contact.tsx save() (lines 43-61): phone regex ^\+?[0-9 ().-]{6,20}$ is lenient enough for the owner's example '+52 984 000 0000' (passes) and strict enough to reject 'abc' (fails). RLS path (client_profiles.preferences jsonb upsert) persisted correctly and was read back verbatim on reopen.

src/sample-content.ts loadSampleContent(): upsert with onConflict:'slug' + ignoreDuplicates:true for exercises, maybeSingle() check before insert for programs, and count query before inserting videos together make re-running the loader idempotent. Verified: 2nd press kept programmes at 3.

app/(tabs)/training.tsx: level filter on video.level (line 57) and goal filter on video.goal (line 58) work on the data shape returned by listVideos(); the duration filter only applies for kind='video' (lines 59-62) matching the spec that goal+duration are hidden for exercises.

success_rate.frontend: 29/36 asserts PASS in one live run. 6 of the 7 'fails' are false negatives from FlatList virtualization/is_visible on off-screen rows (confirmed by subsequent interactions succeeding on the same elements: program-detail opens from program-card-sample-strength-balance, video-complete increments count on the 'invisible' video-detail, etc.) and one is a selector ambiguity on logout (two welcome-screen nodes during the transition, logout did happen). 1 is a real regression: Home stats not refreshing.

seed_data_creation: Cleaned up at the end via Supabase user-token REST (RLS applies, no service_role used). Deleted for the test user only: 0 favorites, 2 workout_history rows, 1 program_enrollments row; client_profiles.preferences.contact reset to empty strings for every key. Sample content (slug prefix 'sample-') was NOT touched and remains published as required. The one real AI/account change budget was not consumed (no coach message, no nutrition plan, no booking, no password attempt, no sign-up).
context_for_next_testing_agent: To finish coverage not run this iteration: Admin CRUD happy/sad path for a 'qa-test-*' trio (programme + exercise + video). Steps are listed verbatim in the task description. Use env KFIT_TEST_EMAIL/KFIT_TEST_PASSWORD. When asserting FlatList row visibility prefer page.locator(selector).count() > 0 instead of is_visible() because the virtualised list hides off-screen items (that bit several asserts this run). The logout assertion should target page.wait_for_url('**/welcome**') rather than data-testid=welcome-screen because Expo Router keeps two welcome-screen nodes in the DOM during the stack transition. The Home-tab refresh bug is reproducible 100% of the time: log in, enroll in sample-strength-balance, complete one session, tap tab-home -> stats still 0.
rca_of_issue: Home stats stale after returning to tab-home. Repro (deterministic): login as admin -> tab-training -> program-card-sample-strength-balance -> program-enroll-button -> program-session-0 -> video-complete-button -> back to program -> tab-home. Expected: home-stat-0 '1', home-stat-1 '45', home-program-percent '25%'. Observed: home-stat-0 '0', home-stat-1 '0', home-program-percent absent, home-program-card in 'no program' state. The underlying data is correct (Supabase REST confirmed 1 enrollment and the inserted workout_history rows at cleanup time). Code path /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:40 uses useFocusEffect, which should re-run on tab focus. Hypothesis: expo-router/unstable-native-tabs (/app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx) does not emit the focus event on tab re-selection; the official replacement 'expo-router/native-tabs' (the warning the deprecation message points to) is almost certainly the fix. Mitigation if the migration is non-trivial: add a plain navigation listener ('focus' / 'tabPress') in Home or move load() into a useEffect with a dependency on a global 'completions' counter stored in auth/user context.
